gallon_share_rules: Use archived WPSR finished motor gasoline products supplied only, release date no later than cutoff.
A week is the seven days ending Friday; allocate its reported daily rate uniformly within the week.
For current weeks not yet published, use demand from the week exactly 364 days earlier, scaled by total current known quarter-to-date demand divided by demand in those aligned prior-year days.
Observed-period expected volume divided by expected full-quarter volume is a national-demand proxy for MUSA share, not company-observed gallons.
No final Q2 2025 company gallons, future weekly releases, current revised demand history, or bare calendar-day fraction.
remaining_margin_rules: Use the production four-feature standardized ridge change regression, alpha 2 and shrinkage 0.5, trained only on verified margins through 2025Q1 and the June16 ALFRED snapshot.
Use 2024 year-end store counts from the 10-K filed February20,2025, normalized across the original three regions; use these PIT weights consistently in training and both forecasts.
Forward-fill each region's last complete paired retail/wholesale week through quarter-end. Retain June9 unpaired retail separately, but do not mix it with a different wholesale observation week.
Apply the fitted quarterly change mapping to June-only four-feature differences versus June2024, anchored on the prior-year Q2 company quarterly margin.

This transfers quarterly coefficients and a quarterly seasonal anchor to an unobserved monthly target. It is an explicit unvalidated research assumption, not an observed June2024 margin or a validated monthly model.
The remaining forecast covers June1-June30 only; the production comparator uses the unchanged production formula on observed complete QTD weeks, with the same cutoff, training inputs and PIT weights.
scoring_rules: Freeze all raw source hashes, normalized input hashes, model code hashes, fitted coefficients and predictions before opening an outcome source in the scoring step.
Outcome and errors are null in forecast.json; score separately without modifying it.
Do not tune any rule or parameter using Q2 2025 actuals. Strict company-observed-gallons replay remains blocked and unchanged.
